name: Castling: the king route
headline:
ROOK UNDER
ATTACK?
body: Check the king’s route before you rule out castling
caption: An attacked rook alone does not rule out castling. Test the right, the gap and the king route in three original exercises. Draft for review
measure: Saves per reach at 72 hours and seven days after approved publication
sequence: Ask whether an attacked rook prevents castling
Reveal yes, no, yes across three constructed positions
Explain the king route and invite practice
